name: Progress Pride flag
description: The six-stripe rainbow flag with a five-band chevron at the hoist — white, pink, light blue, brown and black — pointing toward the fly.
history: Daniel Quasar's 2018 redesign of the rainbow flag, adding the trans colours and black and brown stripes as a forward-pointing chevron; it has become the most widely flown pride flag of the 2020s.

features.symbolism: trans people (white, pink, light blue), communities of colour (brown, black), and those lost to AIDS — the chevron points forward to progress still needed
